status: completed exploratory geometry candidate; valid CAD exports and inspected comparison image; no CFD or fluid mesh
purpose: Make a compact whole-apparatus visual candidate that shortens the rise bend itself and joins directly to the same 1.0 m transition/mouth assembly.

relationship_to_existing_candidate.preserved_dimensions: 1.2 m legacy Bezier rise bend + 1.0 m transition/mouth + 0 m added straight; mouth x=4.8 m
relationship_to_existing_candidate.change: This candidate replaces only the rise-bend centerline with a shorter 0.75 m axial circular-S pair and moves the unchanged 1.0 m transition to start at the bend endpoint. It is a separate geometry branch.

selected_provisional_geometry.rise_bend_shape: two opposite tangent circular arcs in the X-Z plane; same 0.300 m circular pipe section
selected_provisional_geometry.radius_check: Both circular centerline radii exceed the 0.15 m pipe radius.
selected_provisional_geometry.divider_geometry: Retain four vertical closed rounded dividers per outlet; nominal thickness 0.015 m and semicircle radius 0.0075 m, both provisional. Existing aligned ruled transition and station-relative divider layout are otherwise retained.

provenance.source_review_reference_revision: 723fd40 (published rounded-candidate source baseline; compare this extension against that baseline)
provenance.local_workspace_head_at_preparation: 4e54f09; generator contained uncommitted prior rounded-geometry work and this compact extension; no reset or overwrite performed

acceptance_checks_for_geometry_generatio: Pipe/transition union connected and valid at the flush circular interface.
No added straight remains between bend end x=3.35 m and transition inlet.
Transition inlet x=3.35 m and mouth x=4.35 m; mouth x is 0.45 m earlier than the preserved candidate.
Four vertical rounded finite-thickness divider solids per outlet remain valid and watertight in STL.
STEP exports declare millimetres and dynamic bounds match 4350 mm mouth x.
Full assembly STL remains under 10 MB and an inspected before/after comparison shows actual shortening with identical camera and axes.
limitations: The 0.75 m rise run and circular-S radii are selected assumptions to show a compact interpretation, not measured hardware dimensions.
No physical bend radius, exact centerline profile, transition shape, divider mounting or housing-wall dimensions were supplied.
No CFD was run and no existing mesh or solver state was modified. The 406,173-cell mesh is for the earlier 1.2 m bend and must remain tied to that layout.
